title: Write to the neighbour
drDigitalIntro:
Someone needs to water the plants. There is also something in this inbox that should not be trusted.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

One message here is a scam. Find it yourself.

playgroundTask.goal: You wrote a real message and dealt with a fake one
playgroundTask.hint: A scam leans on urgency and asks for something no real company asks for by email. The buttons for answering and filing only appear once a message is open.

steps.say: The scam is out of the inbox and marked as what it is.
You are writing a new message, not answering an old one.
The subject line says what the message is about.
There is something in the body.
The meeting email is filed away rather than left in the inbox.

drDigitalSuccess: You spotted the scam, wrote a message with a subject line that means something, and filed what you were finished with.
drDigitalHint: Read the subject lines — one promises money for nothing. Compose is the button for a brand new message; Archive files one you are done with.
